title: Hit Broadway musical 'Hamilton' comes to Seoul and Busan
caption:
Broadway's biggest hit is making its Korean debut! 'Hamilton' kicks off its world tour in Busan and Seoul this winter. Tickets go on sale November 11th for this English-language production.

Source: Koreaherald - Hit Broadway musical 'Hamilton' comes to Seoul and Busan
